comparison.label_policy: Each cohort uses only labels available at its own period end
comparison.new_customer_definition: Not seen earlier in this snapshot's context; not necessarily new to the entire source
comparison.population: Unique transactions by event time in consecutive equal-duration periods; label updates do not add transactions

delivery.population: valid records in this delivery, including delayed label updates

fraud_exploration.population: Selected training split only; labels available at the snapshot cutoff

scatter.method: Deterministic bottom-hash sample within each class (SHA-256 of the source row); independent of amount and time

population: all accepted context transactions; supervised partitions overlap context

sampling.method: Deterministic hash of source identity, seed, and row ID; independent of label

manifest.verification: Archive size and SHA-256 match the Git LFS pointer at the pinned revision. The downloaded archive was verified before inspection.
